summary: Chang Moi Road and nearby Chang Moi Kao Road have a small cluster of basketry and wicker shops, including Honey Rattan, where visitors can browse baskets, bags, hats, and homewares displayed at street level. Treat this as an independent shop walk and chance to see the retail side of a living craft trade: no reliably documented public workshop or maker demonstration was found.
whyGo: See a concentrated, working retail cluster of woven goods within the old city rather than making a long trip to an out-of-town craft village.
Compare styles and materials across nearby shops, and observe how baskets, bags, and homewares are displayed and sold.
bestFor: Visitors curious about basketry who want an easy, flexible browse between Tha Phae Gate and the Warorot Market area.
Shoppers looking for lightweight woven souvenirs or home accessories and willing to check materials and prices in person.
skipIf: You are specifically seeking a hands-on weaving lesson, guaranteed artisan demonstration, or a scheduled cultural program.
You need a fully accessible route with verified step-free shop entrances and continuous clear sidewalks.
duration: Allow 45–90 minutes to walk the short cluster and browse at a relaxed pace; this is a planning estimate, not a guided tour duration.
cost: No admission charge for walking the public streets. Purchases are optional and prices vary by item and shop; no workshop fee is published because no bookable workshop was verified.
hours: This is a public-street walk, but each shop sets its own hours. Listings for individual Chang Moi wicker shops commonly show daytime business, roughly 09:00–17:30, but hours vary and are not independently confirmed for every shop; check the shop listing or call before making a special trip.
bestTime: Go in daylight on a weekday or Saturday when retail shops are more likely to be open. Starting near Tha Phae Gate and continuing toward Chang Moi and Warorot Market makes this an easy daytime add-on.
gettingThere: The shops are in Chang Moi, between Tha Phae Gate and the Ping River / Warorot Market side of town. Walk from Tha Phae Gate, or use a tuk-tuk, songthaew, or ride-hail to Chang Moi Road; Honey Rattan is listed at 262 Chang Moi Road. Confirm the exact shop pin before setting out.
booking: No booking is needed to browse the street shops. Contact a specific shop directly to confirm opening, stock, prices, or whether staff can explain how an item was made. No public rattan class schedule or booking route was found; do not assume browsing includes a demonstration or workshop.
accessibility: The route follows ordinary city streets and sidewalks, which may be uneven, crowded, or partially occupied by merchandise and parked vehicles. Shop thresholds and interior access have not been documented; step-free entry, seating, and accessible toilets are unverified. Contact shops in advance if access needs matter.
practicalTips: Ask whether a piece is rattan, bamboo, another natural fiber, or synthetic wicker; the shops carry varied woven goods, and materials are not established by a street visit alone.
Ask permission before photographing shopkeepers or interiors, and keep merchandise displays and sidewalks clear while browsing.
If you want an actual lesson, arrange one separately with a named operator and confirm the date, fee, language, duration, and materials before traveling.
decemberNotes: No dated December 2026 event or workshop schedule was found for this shop cluster. Ordinary retail may operate during the month, but individual hours and holiday closures are unverified; check directly shortly before visiting. Daylight browsing is the practical choice.
uncertainties: The district and named shops are supported by travel and local listings rather than a current official district directory; shop identities, stock, and hours can change.
No verified hands-on rattan workshop, public demonstration, published price, or December 2026 booking availability was found.
The referenced photo is a user-published image of a wicker shop on Chang Moi Road; its precise shop identity and reuse permission are not established.
